title: Pass 9 Questions. Prove Your IQ.
hook: Are you smarter than most people?
script:
Are you smarter than most people?
Question 1: Which desert is the largest hot desert in the world?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: Sahara.
Question 2: Which movie famously features the line, 'Here's looking at you, kid'?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is A: Casablanca.
Question 3: What force keeps planets in orbit around the sun?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: Gravitational force.
If you got the first three right, like the video right now.
Question 4: Who directed the 1993 dinosaur epic 'Jurassic Park'?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: Steven Spielberg.
Question 5: What is the smallest country in the world by land area?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: Vatican City.
Score check: comment SHARP if you are still perfect, RUSTY if you already missed one.
Question 6: Which is the only flying mammal?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: Bat.
Question 7: How many bones does a shark have?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is D: Zero.
Are you ready for the last question?
Don't forget to follow and comment your score to be on the weekly leaderboard of the top performers.
Question 8: Which bird can fly backwards?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: Hummingbird.
Question 9: Which language has the most native speakers?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: Mandarin.
Bonus: double or nothing - keep your score in your head and beat it on the next quiz.
Comment your score out of 9, and follow for a new quiz every day.

items.question: Which desert is the largest hot desert in the world?
items.explanation: The Sahara Desert covers a vast area of North Africa, making it the largest hot desert.

items.question: Which movie famously features the line, 'Here's looking at you, kid'?
items.explanation: This iconic line is spoken by Humphrey Bogart's character, Rick Blaine, in the classic film Casablanca.

items.question: What force keeps planets in orbit around the sun?
items.explanation: Gravity is the fundamental force of attraction between masses, holding celestial bodies in orbit.

items.question: Who directed the 1993 dinosaur epic 'Jurassic Park'?
items.explanation: Steven Spielberg brought Michael Crichton's novel to life, revolutionizing special effects.

items.question: What is the smallest country in the world by land area?
items.explanation: Vatican City, an independent city-state within Rome, Italy, is the smallest sovereign state.
